title: A C¹ antilipschitz chart image has approximate tangent space DΦ(w)(ℝⁿ) at Φ(w)
statement: Let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be C¹, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, c > 0 with c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω, and w ∈ Ω. Then T := DΦ(w)(ℝⁿ) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w) is the (unweighted, Simon Ch. 3 Def. 1.4) approximate tangent space of N := Φ(Ω) at y := Φ(w): finrank T = n and lim_{λ↓0} ∫_{η_{y,λ}(N)} φ dHⁿ = ∫_T φ dHⁿ for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∀ w ∈ Ω, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (Φ '' Ω) (Φ w) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap)
